items.title: Public Exploit Code Released for Microsoft SCCM Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.description: Public proof-of-concept exploit code is now available for CVE-2026-47301, a critical remote code execution vulnerability affecting Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM). The disclosed exploit chain could allow a low-privileged domain user to gain SYSTEM-level execution on a Configuration Manager Primary Site Server, creating a potentially serious enterprise takeover risk.
